proof_body:
by
  intro a p q L M hp hq h1 h2 hne
  rintro ⟨A, hA⟩
  have h3 := tendsto_nhds_unique h1 (hA.comp hp.tendsto_atTop)
  have h4 := tendsto_nhds_unique h2 (hA.comp hq.tendsto_atTop)
  exact hne (h3.trans h4.symm)
target_source: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (p q : ℕ → ℕ) (L M : ℝ), StrictMono p → StrictMono q → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => a (p n)) Filter.atTop (nhds L) → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => a (q n)) Filter.atTop (nhds M) → L ≠ M → ¬ ∃ A : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto a Filter.atTop (nhds A)
